_comment: Explicit builds, not zero-config. The static files live in public/ (nginx
serves that directory locally too), and the earlier 'outputDirectory':
'public' made Vercel treat the project as static-only: session.json was
served correctly while every function under api/ 404'd with no build error
anywhere. Declaring both builds is what gets the proxy deployed at all.
routes are ordered and first-match-wins, so the api rule has to precede the
catch-all or /api/gw/... would be looked up as a static file under public/.
